name: Release v2026.10.5
body:
## 🤖 AI-Generated Changelog

## Fixed

- Fixed `--trusted-host` arguments being flagged as secrets in CodeQL security scanning
- Fixed package name parsing in `pipenv update` to correctly handle requirement specifiers as arguments
- Fixed `requirements` command to emit `--trusted-host` for sources with `verify_ssl = false`
- Fixed `requirements` command to correctly join `os_markers` and `markers` with `and`
- Fixed `requirements` command to preserve markers for git/VCS entries
- Fixed `uninstall` command to exit with a non-zero code when pip uninstall fails
- Fixed `uninstall` command to report why it exits 1 when no virtualenv exists
- Fixed pylock group name normalization and added rejection of category name collisions
- Fixed pylock to preserve all categories when reading from `pylock.toml`
- Fixed pylock to keep custom dependency groups in `develop` and `requires-python` as `python_version`
- Fixed pylock to classify packages correctly based on whether they install for default groups
- Fixed docs search by replacing stale Algolia search with Sphinx search
- Fixed integration tests to fail fast when a different `pipenv` version would be tested than the checked-out one

## Changed

- Refactored `--trusted-host` logic to be shared between `requirements` and `install`, preserving environment-variable-defined hosts
- Raised dependency security version floors and extended Python version support to 3.11–3.15
- Dropped Python 3.10 support and addressed related code quality findings

## Security

- Raised minimum versions of dependencies to address known security vulnerabilities

---

🔗 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pypa/pipenv/compare/v2026.10.4...v2026.10.5
